items.title: Vanishing of the sum of the orders of the tame symbols over the height one primes of a two-dimensional Noetherian local ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that for a two-dimensional Noetherian local ring A and nonzerodivisors a, b, the sum of the orders at the height one primes of the tame symbols partial_{A_q}(a, b) is zero (statement lines 1132-1144, tag 0EAW). The proof is a multi-stage reduction: the preparation of the tame symbol together with the key extension lemma replaces A by a finite local extension, the map from A/(ab) into the direct sum of the localised images is shown to have finite length kernel and cokernel so a comparison of periodic lengths applies, and the remaining identity is computed by the multiplication formula after clearing denominators of the local coordinates. Each step is a specific algebraic construction, not a citation, so the claim is H2.
